description: We are Space Seekers, a team of passionate students driven by space exploration, science, and technology. We aim to solve real-world challenges using NASA’s open data, creativity, and innovative thinking. Through teamwork, collaboration, and continuous learning, we strive to transform ideas into practical solutions that benefit Earth and humanity while expanding our understanding of space and the universe.
summary:
## Project Summary – EARTHPULSE: The Earth Information Jukebox 🌍

Team Name: Space Seekeers
Competition:NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
Challenge: The Earth: Information Jukebox
Domain: Earth Science, Data Visualization and Web Development

EARTHPULSE is an interactive web-based platform developed to make Earth science information accessible, engaging, and easy to explore. The project transforms Earth-related information into an interactive experience where users can discover different aspects of our planet through digital content, visual elements, and curated resources.

The platform features an interactive rotating Earth, a search facility, user login and profile interface, and a collection of informational tracks covering different Earth-related topics beyond just audio. It aims to encourage curiosity about our planet and help users understand Earth's environment through technology.

Objective:To make Earth science knowledge more accessible and engaging by presenting scientific information through an interactive and user-friendly digital platform.

Technologies Used:HTML, CSS, JavaScript and web-based resources.

Project Website: EARTHPULSE (Team Space Seekers)

Project Description

EARTHPULSE is an interactive web-based platform designed to make Earth science information accessible, interesting, and easy to understand. It provides users with an engaging digital experience to explore different aspects of our planet through interactive visualizations, informational tracks, and curated resources.

The platform includes an interactive rotating 3D Earth concept, a search facility, user login and profile interfaces, and various Earth-related informational resources.

Main Objectives

  • Promote awareness about Earth and its natural systems.
  • Make scientific information accessible to everyone.
  • Encourage curiosity about our planet.
  • Present Earth-related information through interactive digital experiences.
  • Connect technology with environmental and Earth science education.

Technologies Used

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Web-based scientific resources

Project Theme: Explore Earth. Discover Knowledge. Feel the Pulse of Our Planet.
